en.summary: During a political rally in Nebraska, the US president suggested that Iran could attack major American cities including Los Angeles or San Diego.

en.title: Gauff hits out at racist abuse after China Open incident
en.summary: Tennis player Coco Gauff experienced substantial racial harassment on social media following her victory over Chinese teenager Sun Xinran at the China Open.

en.title: Aussies dealt major injury blow ahead of first South Africa Test
en.summary: Australia will modify its squad composition for the opening Test match against South Africa in Durban due to an injury forcing out one of its key players.

en.title: Republican rebukes Trump for suggesting Iran could 'take out' LA or San Diego
en.summary: A San Diego Republican candidate criticized Donald Trump after the president suggested Iran could attack Los Angeles or San Diego. While Democratic leaders condemned the comments, most Republicans have remained silent on the remarks.

en.title: South Africa in running to stage Africa's first Olympics as 2036 race hots up
en.summary: South Africa was named among seven countries to formally present bids for hosting the 2036 Olympics, vying to become the first African nation to stage the Games. Qatar is considered the frontrunner, with India and Hungary also competing.

en.title: Coco Gauff says 'insane' wave of racist abuse followed disputed point at China Open
en.summary: Tennis player Coco Gauff reported receiving extensive racist comments on social media after a controversial point in her China Open match against Sun Xinran. Gauff had stopped the rally due to distraction from flickering advertising boards.

en.title: ASX to waver as Wall St resets record; US bond yields ease
en.summary: Australian shares are expected to open flat as US markets reach record levels and bond yields decline. Dicker Data announced acquiring a New Zealand distributor, and Lottery Corp's CFO is departing.

en.title: Mystery Canberra collector to offload $10m in 'A+' Australian art
en.summary: A Canberra private collector who spent 25 years systematically acquiring works by major Australian artists is preparing to sell approximately $10 million worth of high-quality art from the collection.

en.title: And now, in the most Trumpian move yet … a war on mosquitoes
en.summary: The US president has launched a campaign against mosquitoes, a position expected to gain public support across political demographics including in Democratic-leaning urban areas.

en.title: Property agent tip-offs surge as AUSTRAC money laundering reforms bite
en.summary: Reports to Australia's financial crimes regulator from property sector participants have increased following implementation of enhanced anti-money laundering measures designed to detect illicit activity in housing markets.

en.title: White House on the defensive after Trump invites Iran to 'take out' LA
en.summary: The US president faced criticism after appearing to suggest Iran could attack two California cities during remarks at a rally focused on Iran policy.
